name: git
description: Git workbench side panel: review staged and working-tree changes, stage/unstage/discard files, commit, and generate AI commit messages.

description_i18n.en: Git workbench side panel: review staged and working-tree changes with colored diffs, stage/unstage/discard files, write and run commits, and generate AI commit messages from the staged diff.
description_i18n.zh-CN: Git 工作台侧栏面板：查看暂存区与工作区修改（彩色 diff），支持添加到暂存、取消暂存（还原到工作区）、撤销工作区修改，一键提交，并可基于暂存内容用 AI 生成提交信息。
